label: The origin relation at a moment never relates a bearer to itself
paraphrase: OPEN analyst commitment: in every history and at every moment, if x bears the selected origin relation to g at that moment, g is distinct from x. This specifies identity of the two relata only. The rationale is that the relation is to a principle from which the bearer derives its act of being, where treating the bearer itself as its source would require it already to be in order to stand as source. A reflexive existence requirement has a different content. The primitive origin relation does not enforce irreflexivity.
